dedupe_keys.name: facility level process based co2 emissions inventory of china s petrochemical plants

description: This dataset is a plant-level inventory of CO2 emissions from China's petrochemical plants that distinguishes energy use, feedstock types, product categories, production processes, technologies, electricity carbon intensity and linked product chains. The Zenodo record says the main supplementary workbook holds all plant-level emissions, production and carbon intensities, and the deposit adds the accounting, analysis and uncertainty code (Jupyter notebooks and CSV inputs), product chain examples and figure files, 63 files of about 48 MB. The latest version (2026) is by Tianyang Lei of University College London and Xiujing Chen of Tsinghua University, free to download under the Apache 2.0 licence. Coverage is mainland China at plant level. Caveats: the reference year and the number of plants are not stated in the part of the record read, and values come from process-based accounting, not measurement. For simulation it gives plant-level petrochemical production and emissions to model how outages or closures of individual complexes ripple through chemical product chains. Related catalogue records include the plant-level decarbonisation pathways of global oil refineries (shared author) and the China coking industry monitoring datasets.
